import csv
import gurobipy as gp
from gurobipy import GRB


def solve_nrm4():
file_path = "Data/NRM4/OnlineSalesinUSA.csv"

with open(file_path, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))

revenue_col = next(col for col in rows[0] if col.lower().strip() == "revenue")
demand_col = next(col for col in rows[0] if col.lower().strip() == "demand")
inventory_col = next(col for col in rows[0] if col.lower().strip() == "initial inventory")

text_cols = []
for col in rows[0]:
sample_vals = [str(r[col]).strip() for r in rows[:20]]
is_text = any(not v.replace(".", "", 1).isdigit() for v in sample_vals if v != "")
if is_text:
text_cols.append(col)

category_col = None
for col in text_cols:
matched = [r for r in rows if str(r[col]).strip().startswith("4U")]
if len(matched) > 0:
category_col = col
break

if category_col is None:
raise RuntimeError("Cannot find the column used to identify '4U' products.")

selected_rows = [r for r in rows if str(r[category_col]).strip().startswith("4U")]

n = len(selected_rows)
revenues = [float(r[revenue_col]) for r in selected_rows]
demands = [float(r[demand_col]) for r in selected_rows]
inventories = [float(r[inventory_col]) for r in selected_rows]

model = gp.Model("NRM4")

x = model.addVars(n, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, name="x")

model.setObjective(
gp.quicksum(revenues[i] * x[i] for i in range(n)),
GRB.MAXIMIZE
)

for i in range(n):
model.addConstr(x[i] <= inventories[i], name=f"inventory_{i}")
model.addConstr(x[i] <= demands[i], name=f"demand_{i}")

model.optimize()

if model.Status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
print(f"Optimal objective value: {model.ObjVal}")
for i in range(n):
print(f"x_{i} = {x[i].X}")
model.write("NRM4.lp")
else:
print(f"Optimization ended with status {model.Status}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
solve_nrm4()

from gurobipy import GRB


def solve_ra7():
problem = "RA7_NYCPropertySales2"

data_dir = Path("Test_Dataset") / "Large-scale-or" / "RA_testing" / "RA7" / "NYCPropertySales2"
products_path = data_dir / "products.csv"
capacity_path = data_dir / "capacity.csv"

with open(products_path, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
product_rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))

if not product_rows:
raise ValueError(f"No data found in {products_path}")

value_col = next((col for col in product_rows[0] if col.lower().strip() == "value"), None)
weight_col = next((col for col in product_rows[0] if col.lower().strip() == "weight"), None)

if value_col is None:
raise ValueError("Cannot find column 'value' in products.csv")
if weight_col is None:
raise ValueError("Cannot find column 'weight' in products.csv")

values = [float(row[value_col]) for row in product_rows]
weights = [float(row[weight_col]) for row in product_rows]

with open(capacity_path, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
capacity_rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))

if not capacity_rows:
raise ValueError(f"No data found in {capacity_path}")

gp.quicksum(values[i] * x[i] for i in range(len(values))),

)

model.write("RA7_NYCPropertySales2.lp")
print("Model written to RA7_NYCPropertySales2.lp")

else:
print(f"Optimization ended with status {model.Status}")

trans_rows = read_csv_rows(folder / "transportation_costs.csv")

places = [row[0] for row in demand_rows[1:]]
demand = [float(row[1]) for row in demand_rows[1:]]
facilities = [row[0] for row in fixed_rows[1:]]
fixed_cost = [float(row[1]) for row in fixed_rows[1:]]
transport_cost = [[float(v) for v in row[1:]] for row in trans_rows[1:]]

model = gp.Model("UFLP1", env=ENV)

x = model.addVars(facilities, range(len(places)), lb=0.0, name="x")

model.setObjective(
gp.quicksum(fixed_cost[i] * y[facilities[i]] for i in range(len(facilities)))
+ gp.quicksum(
transport_cost[i][j] * x[facilities[i], j]
for i in range(len(facilities))
for j in range(len(places))
),
GRB.MINIMIZE,
)

for j in range(len(places)):
model.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[f, j] for f in facilities) >= demand[j], name=f"demand_{places[j]}")
for i in range(len(facilities)):
for j in range(len(places)):
model.addConstr(x[facilities[i], j] <= demand[j] * y[facilities[i]], name=f"link_{facilities[i]}_{places[j]}")

report_solution(model, "UFLP1")

Text Description:
A large industrial factory plans to produce different types of products. The manufacturing process for these products requires time on 10 different heavy machinery devices (A through J). The factory's management needs to create an optimal production plan for the upcoming month to maximize total profit.

All the necessary planning data is available:

Unit Product Profits: The profit generated from selling one unit of each of products.

Device Processing Times: The time (in hours) required on each of the 10 devices to produce one unit of each of products.

Monthly Device Capacity: The total operational capacity (in hours) available for each of the 10 devices during the quarter.

How can the factory allocate its production schedule among the products to best utilize the available device capacity and achieve the maximum possible total profit?

A factory produces two types of food, I and II, and currently has 50 skilled workers. It is known that one skilled worker can produce $10 \ \mathrm{kg} / \ \mathrm{h}$ of food I or $6 \ \mathrm{kg} / \ \mathrm{h}$ of food II. According to contract bookings, the weekly demand for these two foods will rise sharply, as shown in Table 1-11. Therefore, the factory has decided to train 50 new workers by the end of the 8th week. It is known that a worker works $40 \ \mathrm{h}$ per week, and a skilled worker can train up to three new workers in two weeks (during the training period, both the skilled worker and the trainees do not participate in production). The weekly wage of a skilled worker is 360 yuan, the weekly wage of a trainee during the training period is 120 yuan, and after training, the wage is 240 yuan per week, with the same production efficiency as skilled workers. During the transition period of training, many skilled workers are willing to work overtime, and the factory has decided to arrange some workers to work $60 \ \mathrm{h}$ per week, with a weekly wage of 540 yuan. If the booked food cannot be delivered on time, the compensation fee for each week of delay per $ \ \mathrm{kg}$ is 0.5 yuan for food I and 0.6 yuan for food II. Under these conditions, how should the factory make comprehensive arrangements to minimize the total cost? \documentclass{article}

\begin{document}

\section*{Production Planning with Workforce Training}
\textbf{Sets and Parameters:}
\begin{itemize}
\item $T = \{t \in \mathbb{Z} \mid 1 \le t \le 8\}$: Set of weeks.
\item $T' = \{t \in \mathbb{Z} \mid 1 \le t \le 7\}$: Weeks in which a new training program can start.
\item $d_t^I$: Demand (kg) of food I in week $t$.
\item $d_t^{II}$: Demand (kg) of food II in week $t$.
\item $d^I = (10000,10000,12000,12000,16000,16000,20000,20000)$.
\item $d^{II} = (6000,7200,8400,10800,10800,12000,12000,12000)$.
\end{itemize}

\textbf{Decision Variables:}
\begin{itemize}
\item $x_t$: Number of new workers who start training in week $t$, $t \in T'$.
\item $y_t$: Number of skilled workers assigned to train in week $t$, $t \in T'$.
\item $o_t$: Number of skilled workers working overtime in week $t$, $t \in T$.
\item $q_t^I$: Production quantity (kg) of food I in week $t$, $t \in T$.
\item $q_t^{II}$: Production quantity (kg) of food II in week $t$, $t \in T$.
\item $b_t^I$: Backlog (kg) of food I at the end of week $t$, $t \in T$.
\item $b_t^{II}$: Backlog (kg) of food II at the end of week $t$, $t \in T$.
\end{itemize}

\textbf{Mathematical Formulation:}
\begin{align*}
\min \quad & \sum_{t\in T}\left(50*360 + 180\,o_t + 240\sum_{\tau=1}^{t-2}x_\tau + 0.5\,b_t^I + 0.6\,b_t^{II}\right)
+ 240\sum_{t\in T'}x_t \\[4pt]
\text{s.t.} \quad
& \sum_{t \in T'} x_t = 50
&& (\text{Train 50 new workers}) \\[4pt]
& x_t \le 3y_t, \quad \forall t \in T'
&& (\text{Each skilled worker can train at most 3 new workers}) \\[4pt]
& o_1 + y_1 \le 50
&& (\text{Available skilled workers in week 1}) \\[4pt]
& o_t + y_{t-1} + y_t \le 50, \quad \forall t = 2,\dots,7
&& (\text{Available skilled workers in weeks 2--7}) \\[4pt]
& o_8 + y_7 \le 50
&& (\text{Available skilled workers in week 8}) \\[4pt]
& \frac{q_1^I}{10} + \frac{q_1^{II}}{6}
\le 40(50-y_1) + 20o_1
&& (\text{Labor-hour capacity in week 1}) \\[6pt]
& \frac{q_t^I}{10} + \frac{q_t^{II}}{6}
\le 40\left(50-y_{t-1}-y_t+\sum_{\tau=1}^{t-2}x_\tau\right)+20o_t,\quad \forall t=2,\dots,7
&& (\text{Labor-hour capacity in weeks 2--7}) \\[6pt]
& \frac{q_8^I}{10} + \frac{q_8^{II}}{6}
\le 40\left(50-y_7+\sum_{\tau=1}^{6}x_\tau\right)+20o_8
&& (\text{Labor-hour capacity in week 8}) \\[6pt]
& b_1^I = d_1^I - q_1^I,\qquad b_1^{II} = d_1^{II} - q_1^{II}
&& (\text{Backlog balance in week 1}) \\[4pt]
& b_t^I = b_{t-1}^I + d_t^I - q_t^I,\quad \forall t=2,\dots,8
&& (\text{Backlog balance for food I}) \\[4pt]
& b_t^{II} = b_{t-1}^{II} + d_t^{II} - q_t^{II},\quad \forall t=2,\dots,8
&& (\text{Backlog balance for food II}) \\[4pt]
& b_8^I = 0,\qquad b_8^{II} = 0
&& (\text{All demand satisfied by the end of week 8}) \\[4pt]
& x_t,y_t \in \mathbb{Z}_+, \quad \forall t \in T'
&& (\text{Integer training decisions}) \\[4pt]
& o_t \in \mathbb{Z}_+, \quad \forall t \in T
&& (\text{Integer overtime decisions}) \\[4pt]
& q_t^I,q_t^{II},b_t^I,b_t^{II} \ge 0, \quad \forall t \in T
&& (\text{Nonnegativity constraints})
\end{align*}

from gurobipy import GRB

# ----------------------------
# Data
# ----------------------------
T = range(1, 9) # Weeks 1,...,8
Tp = range(1, 8) # Weeks 1,...,7

dI = {
1: 10000, 2: 10000, 3: 12000, 4: 12000,
5: 16000, 6: 16000, 7: 20000, 8: 20000
}

dII = {
1: 6000, 2: 7200, 3: 8400, 4: 10800,
5: 10800, 6: 12000, 7: 12000, 8: 12000
}

# ----------------------------
# Create model
# ----------------------------
m = gp.Model("Production_Planning_with_Workforce_Training")

# ----------------------------
# Decision variables
# ----------------------------
x = m.addVars(Tp, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, name="x") # new workers starting training
y = m.addVars(Tp, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, name="y") # skilled workers assigned to training
o = m.addVars(T, vtype=GRB.INTEGER, lb=0, name="o") # skilled workers working overtime

qI = m.addVars(T, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, lb=0, name="qI") # production of food I
qII = m.addVars(T, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, lb=0, name="qII") # production of food II

bI = m.addVars(T, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, lb=0, name="bI") # backlog of food I
bII = m.addVars(T, vtype=GRB.CONTINUOUS, lb=0, name="bII") # backlog of food II

# ----------------------------
# Objective function
# min sum_t (50*360 + 180 o_t + 240 sum_{tau=1}^{t-2} x_tau + 0.5 b_t^I + 0.6 b_t^II)
# + 240 sum_{t in T'} x_t
# ----------------------------
obj = (
gp.quicksum(
50 * 360
+ 180 * o[t]
+ 240 * gp.quicksum(x[tau] for tau in Tp if tau <= t - 2)
+ 0.5 * bI[t]
+ 0.6 * bII[t]
for t in T
)
+ 240 * gp.quicksum(x[t] for t in Tp)
)

m.setObjective(obj, GRB.MINIMIZE)

# ----------------------------
# Constraints
# ----------------------------

# Train 50 new workers
m.addConstr(gp.quicksum(x[t] for t in Tp) == 50, name="train_50_workers")

# Each skilled worker can train at most 3 new workers
for t in Tp:
m.addConstr(x[t] <= 3 * y[t], name=f"training_capacity_{t}")

# Available skilled workers
m.addConstr(o[1] + y[1] <= 50, name="available_workers_week_1")

for t in range(2, 8):
m.addConstr(o[t] + y[t - 1] + y[t] <= 50, name=f"available_workers_week_{t}")

m.addConstr(o[8] + y[7] <= 50, name="available_workers_week_8")

# Labor-hour capacity
m.addConstr(
qI[1] / 10 + qII[1] / 6 <= 40 * (50 - y[1]) + 20 * o[1],
name="labor_capacity_week_1"
)

for t in range(2, 8):
m.addConstr(
qI[t] / 10 + qII[t] / 6
<= 40 * (50 - y[t - 1] - y[t] + gp.quicksum(x[tau] for tau in Tp if tau <= t - 2))
+ 20 * o[t],
name=f"labor_capacity_week_{t}"
)

m.addConstr(
qI[8] / 10 + qII[8] / 6
<= 40 * (50 - y[7] + gp.quicksum(x[tau] for tau in range(1, 7))) + 20 * o[8],
name="labor_capacity_week_8"
)

# Backlog balance in week 1
m.addConstr(bI[1] == dI[1] - qI[1], name="backlog_I_week_1")
m.addConstr(bII[1] == dII[1] - qII[1], name="backlog_II_week_1")

# Backlog balance in weeks 2,...,8
for t in range(2, 9):
m.addConstr(bI[t] == bI[t - 1] + dI[t] - qI[t], name=f"backlog_I_week_{t}")
m.addConstr(bII[t] == bII[t - 1] + dII[t] - qII[t], name=f"backlog_II_week_{t}")

# All demand satisfied by the end of week 8
m.addConstr(bI[8] == 0, name="final_backlog_I")
m.addConstr(bII[8] == 0, name="final_backlog_II")

# ----------------------------
# Solve
# ----------------------------
m.optimize()

# ----------------------------
# Print solution
# ----------------------------
if m.status == GRB.OPTIMAL:
print(f"\nOptimal objective value: {m.objVal:.2f}\n")

print("Training starts x_t:")
for t in Tp:
print(f" Week {t}: {x[t].X:.0f}")

print("\nTrainers y_t:")
for t in Tp:
print(f" Week {t}: {y[t].X:.0f}")

print("\nOvertime workers o_t:")
for t in T:
print(f" Week {t}: {o[t].X:.0f}")

print("\nProduction and backlog:")
for t in T:
print(
f" Week {t}: "
f"qI = {qI[t].X:.2f}, qII = {qII[t].X:.2f}, "
f"bI = {bI[t].X:.2f}, bII = {bII[t].X:.2f}"
)
else:
print("No optimal solution found.")

\usepackage{amsmath, amssymb}

\textbf{Sets and Parameters:}
\begin{itemize}
\item $Q=\{1,2,3,4\}$: Set of quarters, where $1,2,3,4$ correspond to winter, spring, summer, and autumn.
\item $p_i$: Purchase price in quarter $i$ (10,000 yuan/10,000 m$^3$), where
\[

\]
\item $s_j$: Sale price in quarter $j$ (10,000 yuan/10,000 m$^3$), where
\[
(s_1,s_2,s_3,s_4)=(425,440,465,455).
\]
\item $D_j$: Estimated maximum sales volume in quarter $j$ (10,000 m$^3$), where
\[
(D_1,D_2,D_3,D_4)=(100,140,200,160).
\]
\item Storage cost (/10,000 yuan) per 10,000 m$^3$ for timber purchased in quarter $i$ and sold in quarter $j$:
\[
h_{ij}=
\begin{cases}
0, & j=i,\\
70+100(j-i), & j>i,
\end{cases}
\qquad \forall i,j\in Q,\ i\le j.
\]
\end{itemize}

\textbf{Decision Variables:}

&& (\text{Nonnegativity of purchasing/sales flows}) \\[4pt]
& I_t\ge 0,\quad \forall t=1,2,3,4
&& (\text{Nonnegativity of ending inventory})
